<svg width="300" height="300" viewBox="0 0 300 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest"><metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata>
  <defs>
    <clipPath id="avatarClip">
      <circle cx="150" cy="150" r="128" />
    </clipPath>
    <filter id="softGlow" x="-60%" y="-60%" width="220%" height="220%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="5" result="blur" />
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="blur" />
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
    <filter id="strongGlow" x="-80%" y="-80%" width="260%" height="260%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="7" result="blur" />
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="blur" />
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Pulsing background halo, matches the artwork's own neon blue -->
  <circle cx="150" cy="150" r="140" fill="none" stroke="#00D9FF" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.25">
    <animate attributeName="r" values="136;150;136" dur="2.6s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.35;0.05;0.35" dur="2.6s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>

  <!-- Outer thin dashed ring, slow rotation -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="360 150 150" to="0 150 150" dur="11s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <circle cx="150" cy="150" r="146" fill="none" stroke="#3FB4FF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="2 8" opacity="0.55" />
  </g>

  <!-- Smooth monochrome-blue gradient ring, faster rotation -->
  <g filter="url(#strongGlow)">
    <g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 150 150" to="360 150 150" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      <path d="M 150 46 A 104 104 0 0 1 223.6 76.4" stroke="#00D9FF" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <path d="M 223.6 76.4 A 104 104 0 0 1 254 150" stroke="#1FB8FF" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <path d="M 254 150 A 104 104 0 0 1 223.6 223.6" stroke="#3FA0FF" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <path d="M 223.6 223.6 A 104 104 0 0 1 150 254" stroke="#4C8CFF" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <path d="M 150 254 A 104 104 0 0 1 76.4 223.6" stroke="#3FA0FF" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <path d="M 76.4 223.6 A 104 104 0 0 1 46 150" stroke="#1FB8FF" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <path d="M 46 150 A 104 104 0 0 1 76.4 76.4" stroke="#00D9FF" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <path d="M 76.4 76.4 A 104 104 0 0 1 150 46" stroke="#66E5FF" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" />
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Orbiting particles, cyan/blue tones only -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 150 150" to="360 150 150" dur="4.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <circle cx="150" cy="24" r="4" fill="#00D9FF" filter="url(#softGlow)" />
  </g>
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="360 150 150" to="0 150 150" dur="6.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <circle cx="150" cy="276" r="3.5" fill="#66E5FF" filter="url(#softGlow)" />
  </g>
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 150 150" to="360 150 150" dur="8s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <circle cx="276" cy="150" r="3" fill="#3FA0FF" filter="url(#softGlow)" />
  </g>

  <!-- The illustration itself, with a gentle breathing pulse -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="scale" values="1;1.02;1" additive="sum" dur="2.6s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <image href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omarshagoof/omarshagoof/main/profile-illustration.png" x="22" y="22" width="256" height="256" clip-path="url(#avatarClip)" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice" />
  </g>
</svg>
